headlines.title: President Trump announces submarine shipyard in Maryland
headlines.description: Watch live coverage as President Trump announces submarine shipyard in Maryland.

headlines.title: NBC’s Steve Kornacki Breaks Down Where Midterm Numbers Stand
headlines.description: With midterm elections just a month away, NBC News chief data analyst Steve Kornacki joins TODAY to discuss the latest poll numbers, where the Senate and the House stand, what battleground states to keep an eye on, the major issues on the minds of voters, and more.

headlines.title: Trump Rallies for Republicans Ahead of Midterm Elections
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is making a major push in once-reliable Republican states as a new NBC News poll shows his party could be facing an uphill battle ahead of the midterm elections. It comes as new Trump ads, paid for by taxpayers, get prime-time air, some during football games. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: CIA officer arrested with gold bars admits he exposed secret intelligence source to a foreign official
headlines.description: A high-ranking CIA officer arrested after federal agents said they found more than 600 pounds of gold bars stashed in his home pleaded guilty to wire fraud under an agreement with federal prosecutors.

headlines.title: Cornell Faculty Plan Vote of No Confidence Against Administrators
headlines.description: As protests intensify at Cornell over the university’s handling of an alleged 2024 sexual assault, members of the faculty are now reportedly planning a vote of no confidence against school administrators. It comes as university disciplinary records show the fraternity members allegedly tried to coordinate their responses after Jane Doe went to campus police. NBC’s Maggie Vespa reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Paramount Skydance completes $110 billion ​takeover of Warner Bros.
headlines.description: Paramount Skydance completed its $110 billion ​takeover of Warner Bros., creating a Hollywood heavyweight called Skydance and handing CEO David ‌Ellison control. NBC News' Brian Cheung reports on the details of the merger.

headlines.title: US Calls for Transparency on Reported Russian Plague Death
headlines.description: Russian officials are facing mounting questions after the mysterious death of a 28-year-old Russian researcher at a lab in Siberia that studies plagues. Now, U.S. health officials are calling for Russia to release more information about the death and prevent a potential outbreak. “Something like that gets out, it could quickly spread so we’re watching and monitoring it closely,” Secretary of State Marco Rubio said. NBC’s Ryan Nobles reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: California officials condemn Trump for saying Iran could ‘take out’ Los Angeles or San Diego
headlines.description: California officials denounced President Donald Trump for saying that Iran could “take out” Los Angeles or San Diego, calling his remarks “deranged” and “irresponsible.”

headlines.title: Live updates: The absolute best October Prime Day deals, hand-picked by a shopping reporter
headlines.description: NBC Selected editors are tracking the best October Prime Day deals live, with prices and recommendations updated throughout the event. Here’s what’s worth buying.

headlines.title: How the shooting death of a Houston father is igniting Latino politics in Texas
headlines.description: Lorenzo Salgado Araujo was killed on his way to work by ICE agents, who said he used his vehicle as a weapon. The community is demanding justice.

headlines.title: Police knew who her rapist was. The law kept them from prosecuting him for the attack.
headlines.description: After a certain point in some states, there’s no way to hold a perpetrator accountable for sexual assaults.

headlines.title: Affording America: How a single mother in Chicago turned to gig work to survive
headlines.description: Jade Crossfrench is a single mother supporting three children with a day job selling insurance. But that isn't enough to provide for her family. For over a year she's been making extra money as a gig worker, doing DoorDash food deliveries around Chicago, often with her kids sitting in the back seat of the car.
